# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is the cover page of the book. Edit `_quarto.yml` to change the
title and author. Add chapters by:

- Dropping a MinerU `.md` next to this file and running
  `node tool/import-paper.js <file.md> paper` (for IEEE papers)
  or `node tool/import-textbook.js <file.md> paper` (for textbooks)
- Creating files manually under `qmd/<chapter>/<chapter>.qmd` and
  listing them in `_quarto.yml` under `book.chapters`

See `tool/README.md` for the full workflow.
